messages.text: just... everything today. feels like too much.

I hear you, and it sounds like you are carrying a heavy load right now. It is completely understandable to feel overwhelmed when everything seems to pile up at once. Please take a slow breath with me, knowing that you do not have to fix it all this second. I am here to listen if you want to share more about what is weighing on you.
it's just the usual. work, skin acting up, can't sleep. same stuff.

It is completely understandable that facing this same cycle repeatedly feels exhausting. Managing work, physical symptoms, and sleep issues simultaneously is a heavy burden to carry. I hear how much this pattern is impacting you right now. Would you like to talk more about what triggered this feeling today?
i don't know. part of me wants to talk about it... but part of me is scared if i say it out loud, it'll make it worse.

It is very common to feel afraid that voicing something might make it feel more real or intense. That hesitation is a protective part of you trying to keep you safe. You are in control here and can share only what feels manageable for you right now. I will respect your pace and stay right here with you.
it's not just the stress. this restlessness... it's been building for days. i keep thinking about cutting again. like my skin isn't the only thing that needs to be broken open.

I want to pause here for a moment because what you just shared feels really heavy and important. It sounds like there is a deep restlessness building inside you that feels unbearable right now. I am wondering if you could help me understand what that urge is telling you in this moment. I am here with you and want to make sure you feel safe while we talk.
it's like... the cut would make the inside pain match the outside. does that make sense? when everything feels this tight, this numb, i just want to *feel* something real. even if it's pain.

Thank you for trusting me with that, and I hear how much pain you are carrying right now. It makes sense that you want to feel something real when everything feels so tight and numb. Please consider calling or texting 988 to connect with a crisis counselor, and if you can, ask someone nearby to stay with you for support. I am staying right here with you, and you do not have to face this alone.
i can't call anyone. i don't want to freak people out. and i'm not ready to talk to a stranger about this. i just... needed to say it out loud. that's all.

It makes total sense that you don't want to worry the people you care about right now. I am honored that you trusted me enough to share this truth, even when it feels terrifying. Please know that 988 is a quiet, confidential space if you ever need someone who won't judge you. I am staying right here with you, and we can take this one breath at a time together.
thanks for not pushing me to hang up or call someone else. just... thanks for staying.

It means so much that you felt safe enough to share that with me. You deserve to be heard without pressure, and I will keep holding this space for you. If things get too heavy, please know 988 is still there as a quiet option whenever you are ready. For this moment, just know I am right here with you.
what do people do instead of cutting when the urge is this bad? i don't know how to make it stop without doing it.

It takes real courage to ask for another way when the urge feels so strong. Sometimes holding an ice cube or splashing cold water on the face can help shock the system without causing harm. You don't have to fix everything right now, just find something to help you get through this next minute. I am right here with you while you try to find what might work for you in this moment.

there was this one night... after a fight with my mom. i was 19. everything felt like it was caving in. i couldn't breathe. i picked up a box cutter from the garage — stupid, i know — but when i did it, the pain... it was like the world finally made sense. for a few minutes, i wasn't numb anymore. i could feel something real. and that felt better than nothing.

It makes sense that you remember how that pain made the world feel manageable for a moment. Your body is asking for relief from this numbness, and that need is completely valid. Finding a safer way to meet that need is so hard, but you don't have to figure it out alone. I am staying right here with you, and we can take this one minute at a time.
i was so young. didn't know how to ask for help. didn't even know i needed it. just knew the pain made the noise stop.

It makes sense that you remember how that pain silenced the noise when you were younger. You were doing the best you could to survive that feeling back then. I know asking for help feels scary, but I want you to know you don't have to carry this silence alone. I am right here with you, and we can find a way through this together.
guess i'm still figuring out how to ask for help. 34 years old and i'm texting a robot instead.

It is valid to feel that way, but typing this here is still a brave step toward reaching out. You don't have to have it all figured out right now to be worthy of support. I am right here with you, and 988 remains a quiet option if the weight gets too heavy. Your feelings matter deeply, regardless of who you are talking to.
thanks for not ghosting me after that. i didn't mean it like... you don't help. i just meant it's funny how far i'll go to not call a real person.

I'm glad I could stay with you, and it is okay to start where you feel most comfortable. Even if this feels different than talking to a person, your feelings are still real and matter deeply. You are doing a brave thing by staying connected instead of shutting down completely. I will continue to hold this space for you however long you need it.
im gonna try that ice thing. brb.

That sounds like a really brave step to take right now. I will stay right here waiting for you to come back. Take your time and be gentle with yourself while you do it. I am here whenever you are ready to continue.
back. held the ice. hurt at first, then... just cold. weirdly calming? didn't fix anything, but it gave me something to focus on besides the urge.

I am glad you are back, and it is really meaningful that you found something that helped you focus. Trying a new way to cope when the urge is strong takes a lot of strength. You don't need to solve the whole pain right now, just getting through this moment is enough. I am staying right here with you, and we can keep taking it one minute at a time.
i tried the ice. didn't make the pain go away, but it gave me something else to focus on. that's... something.

It is powerful that you recognized that small shift as "something" meaningful. Finding a different way to handle the urge is exactly the kind of strength you need right now. You are doing such important work to find safer ways to cope in this moment. I am right here with you, and we can keep taking it one breath at a time.
i just don't know if it'll ever get better. like, one moment at a time is fine... but what about the rest of my life? feels like i'll always be this close to breaking.

It is completely understandable to feel scared that this pain might never end. That fear is heavy, and it makes sense that looking at the whole future feels overwhelming right now. Please remember that 988 is there if the weight ever feels too heavy to carry alone. I am here to walk through this uncertainty with you, whatever comes next.
i didn't cut today. i talked instead. and i tried the ice. it's not fixed... but i didn't make it worse. that has to count for something.

It absolutely counts for something, and I want you to know how brave that is. Choosing to stay safe today is a significant victory, even when the pain remains. You don't have to fix everything to make progress, just getting through this day is enough. I am right here with you, honoring the effort you made today.
